1. /**
2.  * Classes and extensions needed to read and parse rules configuration file
3.  */
4. 
5. package org.cqfn.diktat.common.config.rules
6. 
7. import org.cqfn.diktat.common.config.reader.JsonResourceConfigReader
8. import org.cqfn.diktat.common.config.rules.RulesConfigReader.Companion.log
9. 
10. import com.charleskorn.kaml.Yaml
11. import com.charleskorn.kaml.YamlConfiguration
12. import org.slf4j.Logger
13. import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
14. 
15. import java.io.BufferedReader
16. import java.io.File
17. import java.util.Locale
18. import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
19. 
20. import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
21. import kotlinx.serialization.decodeFromString
22. 
23. /**
24.  * Name of common configuration
25.  */
26. const val DIKTAT_COMMON = "DIKTAT_COMMON"
27. 
28. /**
29.  * This interface represents individual inspection in rule set.
30.  */
31. interface Rule {
32.     /**
33.      * @return name of this [Rule]
34.      */
35.     fun ruleName(): String
36. }
37. 
38. /**
39.  * Configuration of individual [Rule]
40.  * @property name name of the rule
41.  * @property enabled
42.  * @property configuration a map of strings with configuration options
43.  */
44. @Serializable
45. data class RulesConfig(
46.     val name: String,
47.     val enabled: Boolean = true,
48.     val configuration: Map<String, String> = emptyMap()
49. )
50. 
51. /**
52.  * Configuration that allows customizing additional options of particular rules.
53.  * @property config a map of strings with configuration options for a particular rule
54.  */
55. open class RuleConfiguration(protected val config: Map<String, String>)
56. 
57. /**
58.  * class returns the list of configurations that we have read from a yml: diktat-analysis.yml
59.  * @property classLoader a [ClassLoader] used to load configuration file
60.  */
61. open class RulesConfigReader(override val classLoader: ClassLoader) : JsonResourceConfigReader<List<RulesConfig>>() {
62.     private val yamlSerializer by lazy { Yaml(configuration = YamlConfiguration(strictMode = true)) }
63. 
64.     /**
65.      * Parse resource file into list of [RulesConfig]
66.      *
67.      * @param fileStream a [BufferedReader] representing loaded rules config file
68.      * @return list of [RulesConfig]
69.      */
70.     override fun parseResource(fileStream: BufferedReader): List<RulesConfig> = fileStream.use { stream ->
71.         yamlSerializer.decodeFromString(stream.readLines().joinToString(separator = "\n"))
72.     }
73. 
74.     /**
75.      * instead of reading the resource as it is done in the interface we will read a file by the absolute path here
76.      * if the path is provided, else will read the hardcoded file 'diktat-analysis.yml' from the package
77.      *
78.      * @param resourceFileName name of the resource which will be loaded using [classLoader]
79.      * @return [BufferedReader] representing loaded resource
80.      */
81.     override fun getConfigFile(resourceFileName: String): BufferedReader? {
82.         val resourceFile = File(resourceFileName)
83.         return if (resourceFile.exists()) {
84.             log.debug("Using diktat-analysis.yml file from the following path: ${resourceFile.absolutePath}")
85.             File(resourceFileName).bufferedReader()
86.         } else {
87.             log.debug("Using the default diktat-analysis.yml file from the class path")
88.             classLoader.getResourceAsStream(resourceFileName)?.bufferedReader()
89.         }
90.     }
91. 
92.     companion object {
93.         /**
94.          * A [Logger] that can be used
95.          */
96.         val log: Logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RulesConfigReader::class.java)
97.     }
98. }
99. 
100. /**
101.  * class returns the list of common configurations that we have read from a configuration map
102.  *
103.  * @param configuration map of common configuration
104.  */
105. data class CommonConfiguration(private val configuration: Map<String, String>?) {
106.     /**
107.      * List of directory names which will be used to detect test sources
108.      */
109.     val testAnchors: List<String> by lazy {
110.         val testDirs = (configuration ?: emptyMap()).getOrDefault("testDirs", "test").split(',')
111.         if (testDirs.any { !it.lowercase(Locale.getDefault()).endsWith("test") }) {
112.             log.error("test directory names should end with `test`")
113.         }
114.         testDirs
115.     }
116. 
117.     /**
118.      * Start of package name, which shoould be common, e.g. org.example.myproject
119.      */
120.     val domainName: String? by lazy {
121.         configuration?.get("domainName")
122.     }
123. 
124.     /**
125.      * Get disable chapters from configuration
126.      */
127.     val disabledChapters: String? by lazy {
128.         configuration?.get("disabledChapters")
129.     }
130.

2. 
3. import org.cqfn.diktat.common.cli.CliArgument
4. import org.cqfn.diktat.common.config.reader.JsonResourceConfigReader
5. 
6. import org.apache.commons.cli.CommandLine
7. import org.apache.commons.cli.CommandLineParser
8. import org.apache.commons.cli.DefaultParser
9. import org.apache.commons.cli.HelpFormatter
10. import org.apache.commons.cli.Options
11. import org.apache.commons.cli.ParseException
12. import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
13. 
14. import java.io.BufferedReader
15. import java.io.IOException
16. import java.util.stream.Collectors
17. 
18. import kotlin.system.exitProcess
19. import kotlinx.serialization.decodeFromString
20. import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
21. 
22. /**
23.  * Class that gives access to properties of a test
24.  *
25.  * @property args CLI arguments
26.  * @property properties properties from properties file
27.  * @property classLoader [ClassLoader] which is used to load properties file
28.  */
29. class TestArgumentsReader(
30.     private val args: Array<String>,
31.     val properties: TestFrameworkProperties,
32.     override val classLoader: ClassLoader
33. ) : JsonResourceConfigReader<List<CliArgument>?>() {
34.     private val cliArguments: List<CliArgument>? = readResource(properties.testFrameworkArgsRelativePath)
35.     private val cmd: CommandLine by lazy { parseArguments() }
36. 
37.     /**
38.      * List of tests provided by user
39.      */
40.     val tests: List<String> by lazy {
41.         val tests: String? = cmd.getOptionValue("t")
42.         tests
43.             ?.split(",")
44.             ?.map { it.trim() }
45.             ?: run {
46.                 log.error("""Missing option --test or -t. Not able to run tests, please provide test names or use --all
47.                          option to run all available tests""")
48.                 exitProcess(2)
49.             }
50.     }
51.     private val declaredOptions: Options by lazy {
52.         val options = Options()
53.         cliArguments
54.             ?.map { it.convertToOption() }
55.             ?.forEach { opt -> options.addOption(opt) }
56.             ?: exitProcess(1)
57.         options
58.     }
59. 
60.     private fun parseArguments(): CommandLine {
61.         val parser: CommandLineParser = DefaultParser()
62.         val formatter = HelpFormatter()
63.         val options = declaredOptions
64.         val cmd: CommandLine
65.         try {
66.             cmd = parser.parse(options, args)
67.         } catch (e: ParseException) {
68.             log.error("Cannot parse command line arguments due to ", e)
69.             formatter.printHelp("utility-name", options)
70.             exitProcess(1)
71.         }
72.         return cmd
73.     }
74. 
75.     /**
76.      * Whether all tests should be run
77.      *
78.      * @return true if command has option "all"
79.      */
80.     fun shouldRunAllTests() = cmd.hasOption("all")
81. 
82.     /**
83.      * Parse JSON to a list of [CliArgument]s
84.      *
85.      * @param fileStream a [BufferedReader] representing input JSON
86.      * @return list of [CliArgument]s
87.      */
88.     @Throws(IOException::class)
89.     override fun parseResource(fileStream: BufferedReader): List<CliArgument> {
90.         val jsonValue = fileStream.lines().collect(Collectors.joining())
91.         return Json.decodeFromString(jsonValue)
92.     }
93. 
94.     companion object {
95.         private val log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TestArgumentsReader::class.java)
96.     }
97. }

36. /**
37.  * Visitor for header comment in .kt file:
38.  * 1) Ensure header comment is at the very top and properly formatted (has newline after KDoc end)
39.  * 2) Ensure copyright exists and is properly formatted
40.  * 3) Ensure there are no dates or authors
41.  * 4) Ensure files with many or zero classes have proper description
42.  */
43. @Suppress("ForbiddenComment")
44. class HeaderCommentRule(configRules: List<RulesConfig>) : DiktatRule(
45.     "header-comment",
46.     configRules,
47.     listOf(HEADER_MISSING_IN_NON_SINGLE_CLASS_FILE, HEADER_MISSING_OR_WRONG_COPYRIGHT, HEADER_NOT_BEFORE_PACKAGE,
48.         HEADER_NOT_BEFORE_PACKAGE, HEADER_WRONG_FORMAT, WRONG_COPYRIGHT_YEAR)) {
49.     override fun logic(node: ASTNode) {
50.         if (node.elementType == FILE && !node.getFilePath().isGradleScript()) {
51.             checkCopyright(node)
52.             if (checkHeaderKdocPosition(node)) {
53.                 checkHeaderKdoc(node)
54.             }
55.         }
56.     }
57. 
58.     private fun checkHeaderKdoc(node: ASTNode) {
59.         node.findChildBefore(PACKAGE_DIRECTIVE, KDOC)?.let { headerKdoc ->
60.             if (headerKdoc.treeNext != null && headerKdoc.treeNext.elementType == WHITE_SPACE &&
61.                     headerKdoc.treeNext.text.count { it == '\n' } != 2) {
62.                 HEADER_WRONG_FORMAT.warnAndFix(configRules, emitWarn, isFixMode,
63.                     "header KDoc should have a new line after", headerKdoc.startOffset, headerKdoc) {
64.                     node.replaceChild(headerKdoc.treeNext, PsiWhiteSpaceImpl("\n\n"))
65.                 }
66.             }
67.         }
68.             ?: run {
69.                 val numDeclaredClassesAndObjects = node.getAllChildrenWithType(ElementType.CLASS).size +
70.                         node.getAllChildrenWithType(ElementType.OBJECT_DECLARATION).size
71.                 if (numDeclaredClassesAndObjects != 1) {
72.                     HEADER_MISSING_IN_NON_SINGLE_CLASS_FILE.warn(configRules, emitWarn, isFixMode,
73.                         "there are $numDeclaredClassesAndObjects declared classes and/or objects", node.startOffset, node)
74.                 }
75.             }
76.     }
77. 
78.     /**
79.      * If corresponding rule is enabled, checks if header KDoc is positioned correctly and moves it in fix mode.
80.      * Algorithm is as follows: if there is no KDoc at the top of file (before package directive) and the one after imports
81.      * isn't bound to any identifier, than this KDoc is misplaced header KDoc.
82.      *
83.      * @return true if position check is not needed or if header KDoc is positioned correctly or it was moved by fix mode
84.      */
85.     @Suppress("FUNCTION_BOOLEAN_PREFIX")
86.     private fun checkHeaderKdocPosition(node: ASTNode): Boolean {
87.         val firstKdoc = node.findChildAfter(IMPORT_LIST, KDOC)
88.         // if `firstKdoc.treeParent` is File then it's a KDoc not bound to any other structures
89.         if (node.findChildBefore(PACKAGE_DIRECTIVE, KDOC) == null && firstKdoc != null && firstKdoc.treeParent.elementType == FILE) {
90.             HEADER_NOT_BEFORE_PACKAGE.warnAndFix(configRules, emitWarn, isFixMode, "header KDoc is located after package or imports", firstKdoc.startOffset, firstKdoc) {
91.                 node.moveChildBefore(firstKdoc, node.getFirstChildWithType(PACKAGE_DIRECTIVE), true)
92.                 // ensure there is no empty line between copyright and header kdoc
93.                 node.findChildBefore(PACKAGE_DIRECTIVE, BLOCK_COMMENT)?.apply {
94.                     if (treeNext.elementType == WHITE_SPACE) {
95.                         node.replaceChild(treeNext, PsiWhiteSpaceImpl("\n"))
96.                     } else {
97.                         node.addChild(PsiWhiteSpaceImpl("\n"), this.treeNext)
98.                     }
99.                 }
100.             }
101.             if (!isFixMode) {
102.                 return false
103.             }
104.         }
105.         return true
106.     }

108.     private fun makeCopyrightCorrectYear(copyrightText: String): String {
109.         val hyphenYear = hyphenRegex.find(copyrightText)
110. 
111.         hyphenYear?.let {
112.             val copyrightYears = hyphenYear.value.split("-")
113.             if (copyrightYears[1].toInt() != curYear) {
114.                 val validYears = "${copyrightYears[0]}-$curYear"
115.                 return copyrightText.replace(hyphenRegex, validYears)
116.             }
117.         }
118. 
119.         val afterCopyrightYear = afterCopyrightRegex.find(copyrightText)
120.         val copyrightYears = afterCopyrightYear?.value?.split("(c)", "(C)", "©")
121.         return if (copyrightYears != null && copyrightYears[1].trim().toInt() != curYear) {
122.             val validYears = "${copyrightYears[0]}-$curYear"
123.             copyrightText.replace(afterCopyrightRegex, validYears)
124.         } else {
125.             ""
126.         }
127.     }
128. 
129.     @Suppress("TOO_LONG_FUNCTION", "ComplexMethod")
130.     private fun checkCopyright(node: ASTNode) {
131.         val configuration = CopyrightConfiguration(configRules.getRuleConfig(HEADER_MISSING_OR_WRONG_COPYRIGHT)?.configuration
132.             ?: emptyMap())
133.         if (!configuration.isCopyrightMandatory() && !configuration.hasCopyrightText()) {
134.             return
135.         }
136. 
137.         if (makeCopyrightCorrectYear(configuration.getCopyrightText()).isNotEmpty()) {
138.             log.warn("Copyright year is not up do date.")
139.         }
140. 
141.         // need to make sure that copyright year is consistent with current year
142.         val copyrightText = configuration.getCopyrightText()
143. 
144.         val headerComment = node.findChildBefore(PACKAGE_DIRECTIVE, BLOCK_COMMENT)
145.         // Depends only on content and doesn't consider years
146.         val isWrongCopyright = headerComment != null &&
147.                 !headerComment.text.flatten().contains(copyrightText.flatten()) &&
148.                 !headerComment.text.flatten().contains(makeCopyrightCorrectYear(copyrightText).flatten())
149.         val isMissingCopyright = headerComment == null && configuration.isCopyrightMandatory()
150.         val isCopyrightInsideKdoc = (node.getAllChildrenWithType(KDOC) + node.getAllChildrenWithType(ElementType.EOL_COMMENT))
151.             .any { commentNode ->
152.                 copyrightWords.any { commentNode.text.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) }
153.             }
154. 
155.         if (isWrongCopyright || isMissingCopyright || isCopyrightInsideKdoc) {
156.             val freeText = when {
157.                 // If `isCopyrightInsideKdoc` then `isMissingCopyright` is true too, but warning text from `isCopyrightInsideKdoc` is preferable.
158.                 isCopyrightInsideKdoc -> "copyright is placed inside KDoc, but should be inside a block comment"
159.                 isWrongCopyright -> "copyright comment doesn't have correct copyright text"
160.                 isMissingCopyright -> "copyright is mandatory, but is missing"
161.                 else -> error("Should never get to this point")
162.             }
163.             HEADER_MISSING_OR_WRONG_COPYRIGHT.warnAndFix(configRules, emitWarn, isFixMode, freeText, node.startOffset, node) {
164.                 headerComment?.let { node.removeChild(it) }
165.                 // do not insert empty line before header kdoc
166.                 val newLines = node.findChildBefore(PACKAGE_DIRECTIVE, KDOC)?.let { "\n" } ?: "\n\n"
167.                 node.addChild(PsiWhiteSpaceImpl(newLines), node.firstChildNode)
168.                 node.addChild(LeafPsiElement(BLOCK_COMMENT,
169.                     """
170.                         |/*
171.                         |${handleMultilineCopyright(copyrightText)}
172.                         |*/
173.                     """.trimMargin()),
174.                     node.firstChildNode
175.                 )
176.             }
177.         }
178. 
179.         val copyrightWithCorrectYear = makeCopyrightCorrectYear(copyrightText)
180. 
181.         // Triggers when there is a copyright, but its year is not updated.
182.         if (!isMissingCopyright && copyrightWithCorrectYear.isNotEmpty()) {
183.             WRONG_COPYRIGHT_YEAR.warnAndFix(configRules, emitWarn, isFixMode, "year should be $curYear", node.startOffset, node) {
184.                 (headerComment as LeafElement).rawReplaceWithText(headerComment.text.replace(copyrightText, copyrightWithCorrectYear))
185.             }
186.         }
187.     }

189.     /**
190.      * Deletes all spaces and newlines
191.      * Used to compare copyrights in yaml and file
192.      */
193.     private fun String.flatten(): String =
194.             replace("\n", "")
195.                 .replace(" ", "")
196. 
197.     /**
198.      * If it is multiline copyright, this method deletes spaces in empty lines.
199.      * Otherwise, if it is one line copyright, it returns it with 4 spaces at the beginning.
200.      */
201.     private fun handleMultilineCopyright(copyrightText: String): String {
202.         if (copyrightText.startsWith(" ")) {
203.             return copyrightText
204.                 .lines()
205.                 .dropWhile { it.isBlank() }
206.                 .reduce { acc, nextLine ->
207.                     when {
208.                         nextLine.isBlank() -> "$acc\n"
209.                         else -> "$acc\n$nextLine"
210.                     }
211.                 }
212.         }
213. 
214.         return "    $copyrightText"
215.     }

217.     /**
218.      * Configuration for copyright
219.      */
220.     class CopyrightConfiguration(config: Map<String, String>) : RuleConfiguration(config) {
221.         /**
222.          * @return Whether the copyright is mandatory in all files
223.          */
224.         fun isCopyrightMandatory() = config["isCopyrightMandatory"]?.toBoolean() ?: false
225. 
226.         /**
227.          * Whether copyright text is present in the configuration
228.          *
229.          * @return true if config has "copyrightText"
230.          */
231.         internal fun hasCopyrightText() = config.keys.contains("copyrightText")
232. 
233.         /**
234.          * @return text of copyright as configured in the configuration file
235.          */
236.         fun getCopyrightText() = config["copyrightText"] ?: error("Copyright is not set in configuration")
237.     }

240.         private val log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(HeaderCommentRule::class.java)
241.         val hyphenRegex = Regex("""\d+-\d+""")
242.         val afterCopyrightRegex = Regex("""((©|\([cC]\))+ *\d+)""")
243.         val curYear = LocalDate.now().year
244.     }
245. }
